:project_name: Ansible Role "Manage Traefik"
= {project_name}

Special purpose Ansible role to manage traefik proxy in "factory" environments.

== What it does

`tasks/main.yml` deploys Traefik as a Docker Compose service:

. Creates the Docker network that Traefik shares with the proxied services (default `traefik`).
. Creates the installation directory with `etc/certs` and `etc/dynamic`, and `etc/acme.json` (mode 0600) when ACME is
  configured.
. Renders `docker-compose.yml` and `etc/traefik.yml`.
. Starts the service with `community.docker.docker_compose_v2`. `remove_orphans` removes services that are no longer
  part of the compose file, for example the Ofelia container of 1.x.

Traefik gets the Docker socket read-only, redirects HTTP to HTTPS and reads dynamic configuration from `etc/dynamic`.
Ofelia is a role of its own: https://github.com/gesinn-it-pub/ansible-role-manage-ofelia[ansible-role-manage-ofelia].

== Requirements

* ansible-core 2.19 or newer (the CI tests the 2.19 floor and the latest release)
* The collection listed in `requirements.yml` (`community.docker` 3.6 or newer) and the Docker Compose plugin on the
  target
* Privileges to write the installation path and to talk to the Docker daemon (usually `become: true`)

== Usage

[source,yaml]
----
- hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure Traefik
      ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: gesinn.manage_traefik
      vars:
        manage_traefik_version: v2.11
----

Further entry points, called with `tasks_from`:

[cols="1,3",options="header"]
|===
| Entry point | Purpose

| `set-log-level`
| Renders `traefik.yml` with `manage_traefik_log_level` and restarts Traefik when the file changed. Pass the same
  values for the other variables that you use for the deployment, they are part of `traefik.yml`. An empty log level
  switches the debug log off again.

| `restart`
| Recreates the Traefik container.
|===

The task file names are part of the interface of the role.

== Variables

The variables are validated against `meta/argument_specs.yml`.

[cols="2,1,3",options="header"]
|===
| Variable | Default | Description

| `manage_traefik_version`
| required
| Tag of the Traefik image, for example `v2.11`.

| `manage_traefik_installation_path`
| `/var/traefik`
| Directory with the compose file and the configuration.

| `manage_traefik_network`
| `traefik`
| External Docker network that Traefik and the proxied services share. Traefik uses it for the Docker provider.

| `manage_traefik_acme_email`
| empty
| ACME registration e-mail. The certificate resolver is only configured when this is set.

| `manage_traefik_acme_resolver`
| `myresolver`
| Name of the ACME certificate resolver, as referenced by the router labels.

| `manage_traefik_log_level`
| empty
| `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARN`, `ERROR`, `FATAL` or `PANIC`. When set, the access log is written as well.

| `manage_traefik_dashboard_enabled`
| `false`
| Enable the dashboard. It is published on `127.0.0.1:8080` only and has no authentication.

| `manage_traefik_extra_certs_folder`
| empty
| Host folder that is mounted as `/etc/traefik/extra-certs`.

| `manage_traefik_manage_service`
| `true`
| Create the network, start and restart the service. Set to `false` to only render the files.
|===

== Handlers

`Restart traefik` recreates the container after a changed `traefik.yml`. Changes of `docker-compose.yml` are applied by
the task that starts the service. Consumers can notify the handler or define a handler with the same name in their play.

== Upgrading from 1.x

* ansible-core 2.19 or newer is required (1.x supported 2.18).
* All variables were renamed:
+
[cols="1,1",options="header"]
|===
| 1.x | 2.0

| `TRAEFIK_VERSION`
| `manage_traefik_version`

| `TRAEFIK_INSTALLATION_PATH`
| `manage_traefik_installation_path`

| `TRAEFIK_ACME_REGISTRATION_EMAIL`
| `manage_traefik_acme_email`

| `TRAEFIK_LOG_LEVEL`
| `manage_traefik_log_level`

| `TRAEFIK_EXTRA_CERTS_FOLDER`
| `manage_traefik_extra_certs_folder`
|===
+
`manage_traefik_version` is required now; the role fails early when it is missing.
* Ofelia was removed (`OFELIA_VERSION`, `handlers/restart-ofelia.yml`). Use `gesinn.manage_ofelia` and run it after
  this role: the first run of 2.0 removes the old Ofelia container from the Traefik compose project.
* `TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD` was removed. It never set a password but enabled the unauthenticated dashboard on
  port 8080. Use `manage_traefik_dashboard_enabled` instead; the dashboard is only published on `127.0.0.1` now.
* The task file `ensure-traefik.yml` is now `tasks/main.yml`, and the handler files are replaced by the entry point
  `tasks_from: restart`. `set-log-level` is called the same way as before.
* The `docker_compose` variable is no longer used. The role uses `community.docker.docker_compose_v2`.
* Traefik mounts the Docker socket read-only. The first run recreates the container for that reason.

== Development

[source,shell]
----
make lint       # ansible-lint, production profile
make molecule   # all scenarios; ANSIBLE_CORE=2.19 runs the floor, SCENARIO=<name> runs one
----

The Molecule scenarios run with `manage_traefik_manage_service: false`: creating the network and starting or
restarting the service need a Docker daemon and are not covered by the tests.
